format: All Competition OS events (Studio, Custom, WSDC, UCWDC, other; baseline for NDCA too)
requirement: DanceFlow baseline policy (not a body rule): individual ballot content is never available by account role; it requires an event-level designation of a role that needs it, a purpose, and an audited reader. Owners and managers see aggregated results and ballot status. WSDC Event Owner/Director/family designees and Raw Score Judges get no content.
interpretation_notes: Least-privilege policy chosen by the owner for bodies whose rules are silent; never to be presented as WSDC, UCWDC or NDCA text. Body-specific exceptions only after verification. Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
